bossAiStateMachineRules.targetSelection: Closest living player in party (or solo player)
bossAiStateMachineRules.phaseTriggerRule: Triggered immediately when HP <= maxHp * phase.at and boss is not hidden; sets GCD = 3.0s

companions.role: Mage/Scholar who guides rune barrier deactivation

phases: Phase 1 (island): Spawn on Sunken Ship deck with Celine, Lain, and Haru; Lain identifies 3 rune seals on the portal.
Phase 2 (switches): Navigate deck and activate 3 rune mechanisms while holding off Pirate Skeletons, Whisper, and Penomena.
Phase 3 (drake): Barrier opens; defeat MVP Drake (180,000 HP) to clear Sunken Story and unlock Sunken Ship & Tier 2 stages.
Phase 1 (intro & siege): Defend Prontera Castle Throne Room alongside guild companions against waves of Orc Warriors, Orc Ladies, and High Orc boss (190,000 HP @ 1:30).
Phase 2 (ceremony): King / Job Master promotion ceremony; player chooses 1 of the 2 Second Jobs for their class and receives exclusive 2nd-Job Emblem accessory (Item ID 22847).

endlessTower.structure: Infinite waves; every wave spawns scaled monster pools and periodic Mini-Boss/MVP encounters with reduced summon clutter and custom Moonlight 50% HP Bell phase (FE).
